headline: Binance Turns To A 647.8 Million Dollar Outflow From A 72.4 Million Dollar Intake
narrative: Binance clean-asset flow turned to a 647.8 million dollar outflow from a 72.4 million dollar intake, so dollars are now leaving that venue instead of arriving. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Clean-asset flow across 79 exchanges turned to a 904.1 million dollar outflow from a 304.0 million dollar intake, equal to 0.3344 percent of the 270.4 billion dollars held on those venues, while Bybit sent out 96.7 million dollars and Bitstamp sent out 34.0 million dollars.
author: jordan
